Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) organised a walkathon along Beach Road in Visakhapatnam on Sunday as part of the Vigilance Awareness Week 2026, reaffirming its commitment to integrity, transparency, and ethical conduct in public life.
The event, centered on this year’s theme “Probity for Prosperity,” was flagged off by Ved Prakash Verma, vigilance officer, HPCL.
Over 300 participants—including HPCL officers, their family members, and students from the Skill Development Institute—joined the initiative.
The walkathon aimed to highlight the critical role of honest, accountable, and ethical governance in building a corruption-free, prosperous society.
HPCL officials emphasised that involving officers, families, and young students fosters a culture of integrity across generations and reinforces collective responsibility.
HPCL through such outreach programmes continues to strengthen public trust and champion good governance practices in both personal and professional spheres.
